notes.title: Bashed.OS - Time for an update announcement.
notes.notes:
Hi there!

Bashed.OS has been recently quiet, as I'm working on a new project, but seeming enough, I feel it's update time!

Bashed.OS will be having another game built into it. A prologue! And it's FREE!

The prologue is still in early development, and I have plans for it. It will be another mode to play, and is optional. And it unlocked whenever the game is started. So, it's not at all a worry!

The project is still in works, as it just started while writing this! It's inspiration, you can join my Discord for news, and ask questions! The original Bashed.OS game will be updated as well.

Such as a major graphic update! This is something I wanted to do for a bit, you'll see a step above it! Thankfully, it's simple for the players! Thank you for the time!

A lot more will be announced as soon as I have news!

notes.title: Big Thanks from the developer!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, working on a small patch to fix a certain bug, up. The bug being an issue with the lighting messing with a few scripts outside, the AI and such, but. This doesn't affect gameplay at all, I should be updating ASAP!

But, first off, thanks for the downloads for Bashed.OS! 

I developed this game from inspiration, and passion. And seeming this is my first game, I'm working on another as well! The game is meant to be something fun, but also memorizing. Work on that memory! 
With that being said, I worked on a lot of updates to support other people's opinions, and suggestions. Nerfs, and balances, and lots of changes, and the new outside mode! It's been fun! Being only 16 of age, and doing this can help start my newest career of this stuff! It's amazing!

I also want to thank the good and bad reviews, even the bad give me an idea of what people want, and such. A few people did contact me, and even made some videos to help out the progress of Bashed, and it was a great help! Thanks so much for the progress of this game, and I'm already on another game! Thank you for the time for this game, if you haven't left a review, please. Give a moment and please leave one. Be honest, good or bad, it's really helpful for people looking at the page of Bashed, if wanted or not. I appreciate the time for the plays of the game! Thank you so much! <3

notes.title: Bashed.OS 2.5 Coming Soon!
notes.notes:
Thanks for playing Bashed.OS!

Recently, I've been a bit busy, but hey! I'm back, and ready to do some updates to this game I call Bashed.OS. Lovely, isn't it?

So, I'm working on several new add-ons to the game, all free as well! No DLC, as the new mode will be known as Hard Mode!

The mode will have the AI harder to deal with, more documents, and a new video. This new video will only be on hard mode. Hard mode will be unlocked automatically once the game is updated. It will have a new environment and lighting. So things can be simple and easy. Not a worry! 

Everything added will be free, as said. New documents, new sounds, new ways to do some stuff, and bug fixes. Here's this update coming VERY soon! Everything is in test, and I am in the process of fixing some stuff up, and optimizing the game for better experience and FPS. 
This wasn't an issue, let alone an issue at all, but I feel if it can be smoother, than I'd like it to be as best as it can be!

I do like to keep progress of this stuff at times, but a major update is coming along, all I ask for is a bit of waiting time, and should be by the end of the week!

Thanks so much!

notes.title: Balance Update Patch Notes: Bashed.OS 1.5
notes.notes:
Heya!

So, balance update. Let me speak about this.

[i]Easier Code Locations[/i]

It is kinda hard to find some of these codes, especially for people that are new completely. This is basically a balance on some you will not have to find a clickable to find one, some will be in plain sight, So, this will be easier to handle! Clickables are still here, but not as consistent on codes. 

[i]Scrolling Balance[/i]

This is mostly for the document tab, the documents have been added a way to counter if you've been to a certain page, completely. Scrolling and dragging was a little downfall, but this update will be changing that completely. You can scroll faster, and place faster. Perfect!

[i]New Enemy![/i]

Well, not really a new enemy to fend off. But, someone may or may not be stalking from aside, just take a good listen at times. Maybe you can hear something walking around, no need to fend off. I think he's just around..

[i]Some new documents, in general![/i]

Added a few of these extra ones, may or may not have a code within one of them! Hope that's blast itself, have fun searchin'!

[i]Ending Change[/i]

New ending in general, as well. A few things were mentioned, and I'm very glad about this. Nobody has managed to beat it, and that is why this patch is coming along. 

[i]Finally, Achievements.[/i]

A few of these are being worked on, which is nice! I'm glad about this. A few will be added along, such as ending and all. Which is just perfectly amazing!


Other than a few of these, this will be coming along very soon. Expect it very soon!

notes.title: Things to say about Bashed.OS!
notes.notes:
Heya there, after watching a few videos on Bashed.OS and along a big perspective on it, I'd like to thank John Wolfe for making things better in perspective. I'm not gonna use an excuse of "It is my first project!"

Otherwords, I pushed out an update regarding a new intro, new loading scene, and fixed some animations up. And I'd like to discuss the problems. 

So! 

I'd like to balance some things up, It does seem like the Taller Man appears more than ever, I am gonna be changing this up instantly. His spawn chance is VERY High in my code, a good 50%, every certain amount of seconds, and such. I am changing this up, and along buffing up the time he will show up as well, so this will make it to where he will only activate a certain amount of time, as well. So, I'm gonna be fixing this up. 

Another good thing to mention, is that there is no way that the documents you have explored, can be deleted and forgotten. I would want this, and this next update has given me more than enough ideas to help the game out. So, In this next update, I am giving a marker to the documents, and along a tutorial update. 

The tutorial will explain more than enough in the chances of hiding, and when to hide, and do all these functions on codes. I didn't explain much on it, and I'm gladly gonna get this fixed, and balanced up. This does seem unpolished, and after this update, It will be lovely as ever. 

Another thing to add, that the codes are apparently too rough, it is hard to mention that.. Well, not hard to mention, just hard to know. That some codes can be found in the Photo Section, and along Network, and such. It was a bad choice to hide these, in there. Why? The player is known for only being told that codes are in documents. 

This is HEAVILY inspired by WTTG, and my first ever project. As said, not an excuse, but inspiration to move forward with balance and such, and along animation fixing, because.. B A D!

Heheh, either way, I'd like to manage some other stuff with the game, that How To Play, will stay. But I'll add a tutorial. Something that explains the game VERY well, and detailed. And I'm glad to function this within this week, hell even tomorrow! By the time people read this, the update should be almost done, in general. I'd like to thank people for playing Bashed.OS and getting managed.

Thank you for the chances!

notes.title: Release - Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Thanks for playing Bashed.OS! 

More than a few updates will be coming along, if you encounter a bug, please post it in the community tab, and I'll figure things out. Back to business. 

---------------------------------------------------

 [i]BASHED.OS 1.1[/i]



- Added Extra Level, just for more gameplay!
- Added Extra Documents

- Added New Video (Torture Scene)

- Added New Ending, with story sum-up.

- Added Extra Locations with secrets, such as Network/Music Tabs

- Added Hiding Mechanic, new way to counter!

- Added extra lights, and balancing for better performance. 

- Fixed an issue for door opening, and Enemy Spawning right away.

- Fixed the whole issues regarding opening the PC and being able to ignore the enemy.

-Fixed issue with spawning outside from the house.

- Fixed some small crashes out.

- Fixed exploit and only exploit to where player can enter the PC while hiding, this was a little tough, but. It managed to work out without creating more bugs. 

- Revamped the main-menu screen, instead of a simple click and freeze, it adds more. Along added and changed the menu screen and background of it. 

- Added new Main Menu animation, this goes for the patch above, too!

- Added cross-hair to help the player navigate in the room, this helps regarding the safe, and along hiding and interacting. 

- Fixed some lighting issues on some pieces of the game. 

- Did some tweak to a little animation on the menu, and in-game.

More updates are coming, regarding balance if there is needed any balance! And along content updates, and these content updates will all be free. More levels, meaning different code location, and interacting on the PC. Perhaps more files. 

Thank you so much for having interest in Bashed.OS!

notes.title: Bashed.os hits Steam, after months of work from an alone developer, it hits stores!
notes.notes:
Hey, hey. 

It's been a good several months working alone on this project, and being a single developer with it going at once isn't easy, but there are WAY better developers that are single in team and make easily better games, heh. This is a dream for me to make it. 

Either way, development isn't over. Even after full release, I plan on making more and more updates. This is a promise. Thanks for purchasing Bashed.os! 

-----------------------------------------------

[b]First off, plans are set. All updates are FREE. Free, free! And most coming soon. Documents, animated videos, and just all that fun stuff for the players. And changing the code very frequently. And even adding levels for that, too.[/b]

Thank you!
